title: Create a new service principal for nightly batch inference job
description: We are moving our nightly price-elasticity batch inference job from a personal user account to an automated identity. Please provision a NEW service principal in Azure Entra ID and register it in the Databricks dev and prod workspaces. The job runs on a Databricks Workflow triggered by Jenkins. The service principal will be owned by our team lead.
business_justification: Remove dependency on personal credentials for a production job (audit finding AF-2026-118).
